data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that highlights source code with many languages and themes.
data.what_it_does: Provides a HighlightView widget that renders code with syntax coloring based on the Highlight.js library. It includes a collection of language definitions and visual themes. The widget works on all Flutter platforms and supports null safety.
use_when: You need to display read‑only source code with syntax highlighting in a Flutter app.
You want a wide range of language support and ready‑made themes without writing your own parser.
avoid_when: You need an editable code editor with features like autocomplete or linting.
You are highlighting extremely large files where performance becomes critical.
strengths: Supports dozens of languages and many themes
Null‑safe and works on Android, iOS, web, desktop
Pure Dart, no native setup required
weaknesses: Performance may degrade with very large code blocks
No built‑in line numbers or advanced UI features
